title: Reading link sites
description: research/reading-links/sites.yaml: the places a reader can read a case or law the site cites, in the order the links show in. scripts/caselaw/reading_links.py reads these settings, checks each link and writes a reading_links block into each source record, which the site shows (site/src/lib/reading-links.ts).

sites.description: Each site by its id, which the site's pages use as data-reading-site.

citationKind.description: A kind of citation the script recognizes in a source record.

short.description: A shorter label the link shows instead of label.

access.description: official: the government's own text. free. subscription: needs an account (Westlaw, Lexis). background: not legal authority (Wikipedia).

check.description: How the script checks a link before it is shown: get (answers 200 after redirects), redirect (answers with a redirect), api (the site's own data service confirms the item) or none (the site turns away automated checks; the link is marked unchecked).

additionalProperties.description: An address pattern with placeholders such as {volume} and {page}.

links.description: The address pattern for each kind of citation; 'any' serves every kind in 'for', and 'supreme-court-docket' is the pattern by docket number.
